archetype: Melee burst bossing thief. Single-target burst built around Assassinate, with Meso Explosion as a secondary damage engine and Dark Sight as a defensive layer.

linkSkill.name: Thief's Cunning

legionEffect: Legion block grants flat LUK (+10 / +20 / +40 / +80 / +100 by block rank).

vMatrix.notes: The V Matrix does not exist for a Lv 140 character - 5th job is reached at Lv 200 - so this section is forward-planning only at the level given. Grandis Library's Primary/Secondary/Other tiering for Shadower (Node 1 Assassinate; Node 2 Meso Explosion; Node 3 Dark Flare + Cruel Stab; Node 4 Sudden Raid + Shadow Veil; Node 5 Phase Dash; Node 6 Midnight Carnival + Savage Blow) is a restatement of the class doc per its own credits block, so it is not an independent confirmation. No source reachable in this pass gives a numeric node-leveling roadmap (which node to take to 25/30/40/50/60 in what order); the class doc explicitly does not contain one.

order.why: The class doc places the origin skill first. It is a long-cooldown burst that grants invincibility during the cast and carries Ignore Defense and Boss Damage breakpoints at node levels 10, 20 and 30.

order.step: HEXA Assassinate, then HEXA Pulverize (Mastery Node/Core 1)
order.why: The class doc ranks this mastery core second. Assassinate periodically upgrades into Pulverize, so both halves of the core are part of the main attack cycle.
The class doc ranks it third and states it is gated behind having the Meso Explosion boost node at Lv. 40 or higher.

order.step: HEXA Dark Flare and HEXA Cruel Stab (Mastery Node/Core 3)
order.why: The class doc ranks this core fourth and states each half is gated behind the matching 3rd/4th job skill's boost node being at Lv. 40 or higher.

order.step: HEXA Sudden Raid, HEXA Shadow Veil, Covert Edge (Mastery Node/Core 4)
order.why: The class doc ranks this core fifth.
The class doc places the second skill core after the four mastery cores.

order.step: Sol Janus: Dusk / Sol Janus: Dawn (common nodes)
order.why: The class doc places these last and says the level chosen depends on the individual player's needs rather than giving a fixed target.

hexa.notes: SINGLE-SOURCE WARNING: the entire HEXA investment order above comes from one document, the Shadower Discord's class doc. No second independent source for Shadower HEXA ordering was reachable in this pass. Grandis Library has no HEXA section for any class. MapleDoro's Shadower page shows 'Coming soon' for both its Heroic and Interactive 6th-job leveling tabs. MapleGains, a GMS-data HEXA optimizer, does not yet support Shadower. The class doc's own HEXA Stat section is a stub that links into the Shadower Discord, so no HEXA Stat line priority could be sourced at all and that field is null. The class doc carries no last-updated date and no named author, so its currency against v.271 cannot be established from the document itself. Every node name above was validated against MapleStory Wiki's Shadower skill table. Mechanically HEXA opens at Lv 260, so none of this is actionable for a Lv 140 character.

hyperStats.notes: Single-source. Grandis Library publishes no hyper stat data for any class, and neither MapleDoro nor the independent trio table covers hyper stats, so no second opinion was reachable. Treat the ordering as indicative, not settled: hyper stat allocation depends on a character's current crit rate, IED and boss damage, and the community's operative answer is a per-character calculator rather than a fixed list. Hyper stats unlock at Lv 140, so this is the layer that is actually actionable at the level given.

hyperSkills.notes: The five mandatory passives are the only Shadower claim in this file with two genuinely independent sources behind it, and the second of those is stale (a 2022 page, pre-6th-job), so treat it as corroboration of a long-stable pick list rather than a fresh second opinion. Grandis Library lists the identical five picks but credits the class doc, so it adds nothing. Hyper skill actives could not be sourced from a current page and are left null rather than guessed. Hyper skills unlock at Lv 140.

lines: Legendary first line: Boss Damage +20% (on Reboot/Heroic the class doc instead recommends Meso Obtained +20% - see notes)
Unique/Epic: Damage to enemies with Abnormal Status +8%
Meso Obtained +20% and/or Item Drop Rate +20% on the available lines
Unique: Critical Rate +15-20% while the Legion is still small. The class doc frames this as a stopgap for players below roughly 8k Legion, to be replaced once crit rate is covered from other sources.

innerAbility.notes: The class doc specifically recommends Meso Obtained on Reboot/Heroic because of the server's multiplied meso rate, which compounds with Shadower's own meso mechanics. MapleDoro is the one independent page found that publishes a Shadower inner ability recommendation; it lists Boss Damage +20% (Legendary), Attack +21 (Unique) and Damage to enemies with Abnormal Status +8% (Epic) for both bossing and mobbing, and it is undated with no maintainer named. Grandis Library's inner ability block is credited to the class doc, so it is not a third vote.

gearingNotes: Crit rate is unusually cheap for this class. The class doc says Shadower assembles most of it from its own kit - roughly 50% between Flip the Coin and Critical Edge, plus base crit - and then tops up to 100% with Decent Sharp Eyes, the Beast Tamer link, Night Lord and Marksman Legion ranks and Legion/hyper stat points, leaving roughly 15% to buy. The practical consequence is that once 100% is reached, hyper stat and inner ability points other classes spend on crit rate are free to go elsewhere. Ignore Enemy Defense: Shadower Instinct supplies a 20% IED buff, and the class doc gives visual-IED targets of roughly 96-97% for 380 PDR bosses, 93-95% for Black Mage and Chaos Tenebris, and 91%+ for earlier bosses. Meso: the class doc states Shadower carries a 20% additive Meso Obtained effect that other classes do not have, which is why Meso Obtained lines are recommended on Reboot/Heroic. Attack speed: the doc's stack is base 6, Booster +2, green potion +1, Decent Speed Infusion +1, and it takes the position that reaching 0 attack speed is not required. Secondary weapon: the doc names Deimos Shield as BIS - note Shadower can equip a shield rather than a throwing-star-class secondary, which is a real gearing difference from Night Lord. Potential: the doc recommends at least two lines of 8% critical damage on gloves. All of the above is single-sourced to the class doc; none of it was confirmed by a second independent page in this pass.

commonMistakes.mistake: Building a HEXA mastery core before its underlying boost node is high enough. The class doc states HEXA Meso Explosion requires the Meso Explosion boost node at Lv. 40+, and that HEXA Dark Flare and HEXA Cruel Stab carry the same requirement on their own boost nodes.
Chasing 0 attack speed. The class doc says it is not necessary for Shadower.

Treating Grandis Library's Shadower page as a second opinion on inner ability, hyper passives or boost nodes. Its own credits block attributes exactly those three fields to the class doc, so agreement between the two is one source agreeing with itself.

contest.method: An independent agent re-searched every claim in this file without seeing the researcher's reasoning, and was instructed to refute rather than confirm.
defects: Bossing-mule trio third member: the file states the 1-node setup is Assassinate / Meso Explosion / Dark Flare. The class doc's actual text names Cruel Stab ('You can use cruel stab node to help level'), not Dark Flare. Trio memberships in the doc are image icons with no text enumeration, so Dark Flare was reconstructed. Recorded conflict #1 is built on this incorrect reading.

The entire seven-step hexa.order sequence as a sourced priority order. The class doc conveys its 'Sixth Job Upgrade Order' only as an embedded image; no text list states any ordering. The published sequence is identical to MapleStory Wiki's game-data slot numbering (Skill Node/Core 1, Mastery Node/Core 1, 2, 3, 4, Skill Node/Core 2, common), which is the expected signature of an order reconstructed from a data table and then attributed to a guide's judgement.
'Flip the Coin' in gearingNotes - the actual skill name on MapleStory Wiki is 'Flip of the Coin' (Hyper Skill, Active, Level Requirement 140, Critical Rate +25%, Damage +24%).

OMISSION rather than invention, but equally material: Decent Holy Symbol is named a mandatory boost node by the class doc and appears nowhere in the file. This also falsifies the file's claim that 'the doc gives no second full trio for a main' - the doc has a 2-node setup with two trios.

blockedReason: 4 claim(s) did not survive independent re-checking. See contest.defects. This file is research, not guidance, until they are resolved.
